name: Voltura
description: A dark-luxe trading workspace where inky olive panels float on a sun-baked citrine field and one acid-lime focal card always carries the eye.
concept: Voltura treats a crypto cockpit like a piece of industrial signage. Deep charcoal-olive cards sit on a saturated citrine canvas, separated by hairline borders rather than heavy shadows. A single luminous lime panel anchors every screen, so the layout reads as a constellation of muted instruments orbiting one bright signal.

palette.name: Citrine Field
palette.role: Outer page canvas, the warm olive-lime ground the app sits on

palette.name: Inkwell
palette.role: Primary app surface and sidebar; the deep olive-charcoal that holds the data grid

palette.name: Slate Panel
palette.role: Lifted card surface inside the dark canvas

palette.name: Acid Lime
palette.role: Signature focal accent for the highlight card, primary buttons, and active states

palette.name: Bone
palette.role: Primary text and high-contrast labels on dark surfaces

palette.name: Moss Mute
palette.role: Secondary text, captions, and muted iconography

palette.name: Hairline
palette.role: 1px borders, dividers, and subtle card edges

palette.name: Signal Coral
palette.role: Categorical accent for distribution bars and warning chips

fonts.name: Space Grotesk
fonts.usage: Display numbers, balances, KPIs, and headlines

fonts.name: Inter
fonts.usage: Interface body text, labels, navigation, and table copy

fonts.name: JetBrains Mono
fonts.usage: Ticker symbols, transaction IDs, and inline code-style values

iconPack.name: Tabler Icons
iconPack.usage: Used for sidebar navigation, action buttons, asset tags, and dashboard utility icons with consistent 1.5px outline strokes.
